description: Honest AgentPad volume from real on-chain Trade events: gross volume, volume excluding each creator wallet, net ETH in (buys minus sells), unique trader wallets, and whether creators traded their own coin. Platform-wide plus per token. Optional token (symbol or 0x). Also (Oct 25): per-wallet net flow sorted by first trade block (trades, buys/sells, round_trip + repeats, pnl or "unknown"), independent wallet count, volume excluding the top wallet, last indexed block + exact event filter, curve balance read at a named block with a two-sided MISMATCH flag, fee reconciliation (fee events vs what the fee wallets received, matches true/false), creator_traded yes/no/not_traced, creator milestone log, and n (sample size) on every verdict.
name: honest_volume
